class OCREngine:
    def __init__(self, model_id, dtype, max_new_tokens):
        self.model_id = model_id
        self.dtype = dtype
        self.max_new_tokens = max_new_tokens
        self.model = None
        self.processor = None
        self._lock = threading.Lock()  # serialize inference (CPU, shared model)

    def load(self):
        print('[engine] loading processor from %s ...' % self.model_id, flush=True)
        self.processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained(self.model_id)
        print('[engine] loading model (dtype=%s, cpu) ...' % self.dtype, flush=True)
        t0 = time.time()
        self.model = GlmOcrForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(
            self.model_id, dtype=self.dtype, device_map='cpu'
        )
        self.model.eval()
        print('[engine] model loaded in %.1fs' % (time.time() - t0), flush=True)

    def ocr_image(self, image_path):
        """Run OCR on a single image file. Returns recognized text."""
        with self._lock:
            messages = [
                {
                    'role': 'user',
                    'content': [
                        {'type': 'image', 'url': image_path},
                        {'type': 'text', 'text': 'Text Recognition:'},
                    ],
                }
            ]
            inputs = self.processor.apply_chat_template(
                messages, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True,
                return_dict=True, return_tensors='pt',
            ).to(self.model.device)
            prompt_len = inputs['input_ids'].shape[1]
            with torch.no_grad():
                out = self.model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=self.max_new_tokens)
            new_tokens = out[0][prompt_len:]
            text = self.processor.decode(new_tokens, skip_special_tokens=True)
            return text.strip()

class PageSource:
    def __init__(self, source, source_type):
        self.source = source
        self.source_type = source_type

    def page_count(self):
        if self.source_type == 'pdf':
            if fitz is None:
                raise RuntimeError('PyMuPDF (fitz) is required to open PDFs. Install with: pip install PyMuPDF')
            doc = fitz.open(self.source)
            n = doc.page_count
            doc.close()
            return n
        else:
            files = [f for f in os.listdir(self.source) if os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower() in IMAGE_EXTS]
            return len(files)

    def sorted_image_files(self):
        files = [f for f in os.listdir(self.source) if os.path.splitext(f)[1].lower() in IMAGE_EXTS]
        files.sort(key=lambda x: (len(x), x))
        return files

    def ensure_page_image(self, book_id, page_num, store):
        """Return path to the page image, rendering from PDF if needed."""
        dest = store.page_image_path(book_id, page_num)
        if os.path.exists(dest):
            return dest
        if self.source_type == 'pdf':
            doc = fitz.open(self.source)
            page = doc[page_num - 1]
            pix = page.get_pixmap(dpi=RENDER_DPI)
            pix.save(dest)
            doc.close()
            return dest
        else:
            files = self.sorted_image_files()
            if page_num - 1 >= len(files):
                raise RuntimeError('Page %d not found in image directory' % page_num)
            src = os.path.join(self.source, files[page_num - 1])
            # copy into book dir so it's self-contained
            shutil.copyfile(src, dest)
            return dest

    def _process_page(self, book_id, page_num):
        book = self.store.get(book_id)
        src = PageSource(book['source'], book['source_type'])
        self.store.set_page_status(book_id, page_num, 'processing')
        image_path = src.ensure_page_image(book_id, page_num, self.store)
        text = self.engine.ocr_image(image_path)
        if not text:
            raise RuntimeError('OCR returned empty text')
        self.store.write_page_text(book_id, page_num, text)
        self.store.set_page_status(book_id, page_num, 'completed')

    def enqueue(self, book_id, page_nums):
        for n in page_nums:
            self.queue.put((book_id, n))

    def process_all(self, book_id):
        book = self.store.get(book_id)
        nums = [p['num'] for p in book['pages'] if p['status'] in ('pending', 'failed')]
        self.enqueue(book_id, nums)
        return nums

    def retry_failed(self, book_id):
        book = self.store.get(book_id)
        nums = [p['num'] for p in book['pages'] if p['status'] == 'failed']
        self.enqueue(book_id, nums)
        return nums

    def export(self, book_id, fmt):
        book = self.store.get(book_id)
        parts = []
        for p in book['pages']:
            text = self.store.read_page_text(book_id, p['num'])
            if fmt == 'md':
                parts.append('## Page %d\n\n%s\n' % (p['num'], text))
            else:
                parts.append('--- Page %d ---\n%s\n' % (p['num'], text))
        header = '# %s\n\n' % book['name'] if fmt == 'md' else '%s\n\n' % book['name']
        content = header + '\n'.join(parts)
        outdir = self.store._export_dir(book_id)
        os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
        outpath = os.path.join(outdir, 'book.%s' % fmt)
        with open(outpath, 'w') as f:
            f.write(content)
        return outpath, content

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    app = None  # set by server

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        sys.stderr.write('[http] ' + (fmt % args) + '\n')

    def _send(self, code, body, ctype='application/json'):
        if isinstance(body, str):
            body = body.encode('utf-8')
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', ctype)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _json(self, obj, code=200):
        self._send(code, json.dumps(obj))

    def _err(self, msg, code=400):
        self._json({'error': msg}, code)

    def _read_body(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        raw = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b''
        if not raw:
            return {}
        try:
            return json.loads(raw)
        except Exception:
            return {}

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(204)
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS')
        self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type')
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        u = urlparse(self.path)
        path = u.path
        try:
            if path == '/' or path == '/index.html':
                self._send(200, INDEX_HTML, 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
            elif path == '/api/books':
                self._json({'books': self.app.store.list_books()})
            elif path == '/api/health':
                self._json({'ok': True, 'model_loaded': self.app.engine.model is not None})
            elif re.match(r'^/api/books/([^/]+)$', path):
                m = re.match(r'^/api/books/([^/]+)$', path)
                bid = m.group(1)
                if not self.app.store.exists(bid):
                    return self._err('book not found', 404)
                self._json(self.app.store.get(bid))
            elif re.match(r'^/api/books/[^/]+/pages/\d+/image$', path):
                m = re.match(r'^/api/books/([^/]+)/pages/(\d+)/image$', path)
                bid, n = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
                p = self.app.store.page_image_path(bid, n)
                if not os.path.exists(p):
                    return self._err('image not found', 404)
                self._serve_file(p, 'image/png')
            elif re.match(r'^/api/books/[^/]+/pages/\d+/text$', path):
                m = re.match(r'^/api/books/([^/]+)/pages/(\d+)/text$', path)
                bid, n = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
                self._json({'text': self.app.store.read_page_text(bid, n)})
            elif re.match(r'^/api/books/[^/]+/export/(md|txt)$', path):
                m = re.match(r'^/api/books/([^/]+)/export/(md|txt)$', path)
                bid, fmt = m.group(1), m.group(2)
                outpath, content = self.app.export(bid, fmt)
                ctype = 'text/markdown' if fmt == 'md' else 'text/plain'
                self._send(200, content, ctype + '; charset=utf-8')
            else:
                self._err('not found', 404)
        except Exception as e:
            self._err(str(e), 500)

    def _serve_file(self, path, ctype):
        with open(path, 'rb') as f:
            data = f.read()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', ctype)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def do_POST(self):
        u = urlparse(self.path)
        path = u.path
        body = self._read_body()
        try:
            if path == '/api/books':
                source = body.get('source', '').strip()
                name = body.get('name', '').strip()
                if not source:
                    return self._err('source is required')
                if not os.path.exists(source):
                    return self._err('source path does not exist: %s' % source, 400)
                if source.lower().endswith('.pdf'):
                    stype = 'pdf'
                elif os.path.isdir(source):
                    stype = 'images'
                else:
                    return self._err('source must be a PDF file or a directory of images', 400)
                if not name:
                    name = os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(source))
                src = PageSource(source, stype)
                page_count = src.page_count()
                if page_count == 0:
                    return self._err('no pages found in source', 400)
                book = self.app.store.create(name, source, stype, page_count)
                self._json(book, 201)
            elif re.match(r'^/api/books/[^/]+/process$', path):
                m = re.match(r'^/api/books/([^/]+)/process$', path)
                bid = m.group(1)
                if not self.app.store.exists(bid):
                    return self._err('book not found', 404)
                nums = self.app.process_all(bid)
                self._json({'queued': nums})
            elif re.match(r'^/api/books/[^/]+/retry$', path):
                m = re.match(r'^/api/books/([^/]+)/retry$', path)
                bid = m.group(1)
                if not self.app.store.exists(bid):
                    return self._err('book not found', 404)
                nums = self.app.retry_failed(bid)
                self._json({'queued': nums})
            else:
                self._err('not found', 404)
        except Exception as e:
            self._err(str(e), 500)

    def do_PUT(self):
        u = urlparse(self.path)
        path = u.path
        body = self._read_body()
        try:
            m = re.match(r'^/api/books/([^/]+)/pages/(\d+)/text$', path)
            if m:
                bid, n = m.group(1), int(m.group(2))
                if not self.app.store.exists(bid):
                    return self._err('book not found', 404)
                text = body.get('text', '')
                self.app.store.write_page_text(bid, n, text)
                # mark completed if it was pending/failed and now has text
                book = self.app.store.get(bid)
                page = book['pages'][n-1]
                if page['status'] in ('pending', 'failed'):
                    self.app.store.set_page_status(bid, n, 'completed')
                self._json({'ok': True})
            else:
                self._err('not found', 404)
        except Exception as e:
            self._err(str(e), 500)

    def do_DELETE(self):
        u = urlparse(self.path)
        path = u.path
        try:
            m = re.match(r'^/api/books/([^/]+)$', path)
            if m:
                bid = m.group(1)
                if not self.app.store.exists(bid):
                    return self._err('book not found', 404)
                self.app.store.delete(bid)
                self._json({'ok': True})
            else:
                self._err('not found', 404)
        except Exception as e:
            self._err(str(e), 500)
